A focused direct Global Search API browser journey now verifies assigned-client hits, sibling-client and foreign-firm no-hit/no-count behavior, ClientUser denial, revoked-grant empty results, and stale-session 401; ranking/candidate behavior and exhaustive role/scope cases remain open; technical-library audience and firm isolation now have focused coverage. remainingLocalWork.details: Committed at cee546f9 (2026-10-10): versioned firm pricing policy per currency with a distinct second rule administrator (fee band, optional discount cap, validity window) bounding new quotations; append-only quotation-approval revocations that block dispatch and acceptance until a fresh approval; quotation validity expiry enforced at dispatch and acceptance; acceptance requires the signatory email and it must match the dispatch recipient or the lead primary contact; commercial mail receipt states QUEUED/DISPATCHED/PROVIDER_ACCEPTED/REJECTED/UNKNOWN with a database guard that keeps a provider-verified receipt terminal; Angular pricing-policy, revocation and receipt views; migration 20261010185946_CommercialPricingPolicyAndDeliveryReceipts. remainingLocalWork.item: FSR-002 / FSR-010 / FSR-011 first slice — typed statement presentation as genuine PDF, Word and Excel (unapproved draft)
remainingLocalWork.details:
Working-tree slice based on 789793905330922209a6873ac3da81eb1e848c3b, implementing the recommended first slice of the NAQAHA implementation stories. The SFP and profit-or-loss statements use persisted package lines evaluated through a published, same-client/framework statement layout; presentation remains explicitly UNAPPROVED_DRAFT. Current and supplied comparative columns are displayed with server-computed values, persisted note cross-casts, blocking balance/mapping/sign/equation/footing checks, and rounding warnings. PDF, DOCX and XLSX are genuine deterministic outputs from one presentation model; XLSX values are numeric and have no formulas. API GET/export routes enforce package scope; export validates CSRF and carries the artifact hash. No migration; existing package artifacts remain unchanged. Fixture data is synthetic and matches selected reference arithmetic only; it is not the customer ledger or accountant-approved. Observed on this working tree: Release solution build succeeded with six NU1900 vulnerability-feed warnings and zero errors; focused Domain tests 24/24; API UiContractTests 1/1; Angular CI suite 634/634; Angular production build passed with the existing commercial-settings stylesheet budget warning; EF model has no pending changes; OpenAPI drift, Markdown documentation, filename, narrative-metric, Angular inventory and git diff checks passed. Built-in browser rendered the local Angular shell and its unauthenticated access guard. The local API/session service was unavailable, so no signed-in package view or record-level browser journey was observed. NOT DONE: FSR-001/T003 professional framework, period and fixture approval; full approved brand/layout policy; complete cash-flow, equity and disclosure-note presentation; automatic note numbering; complete source-lineage and cross-statement acceptance; report composition and full artifact sealing; independent management/audit approvals; legal sign-off, production certificate trust/timestamp, release/archive and production pilot. Observed: Application Release build passed with one NU1900 vulnerability-feed warning; FinancialStatementPresentationTests passed 15/15; the targeted Angular presentation spec passed 4/4; Angular production build passed with the existing commercial-settings stylesheet budget warning; modified Domain test assembly compiled; Markdown, filename, narrative-metric, status JSON and diff checks passed. The PostgreSQL-backed StatementPresentation_RequiresAPublishedLayout_AndIsScopedAndRepeatable test was not run: the required loopback PostgreSQL service was down, and startup failed because its data directory reported a shared-memory block still in use. The in-app browser did not reach the local dev-server route, so no authenticated screen journey was observed. The FSR backlog remains PARTIAL; this does not close the professional, composition, sealing, signing or release gates.
